attributes.title: AONL 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
AONL 2027, the annual conference of the American Organization for Nursing Leadership, takes place April 12 to 15, 2027, in Phoenix, Arizona. The audience is nurse leaders, from front-line managers to chief nursing officers.

AONL advertises more than 40 hours of continuing education, depending on which sessions are attended; it is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development. Registration is open. The full conference is listed at $1,325 for AONL members and $1,650 for non-members, with early-bird pricing through February 26, 2027; AONL does not say what the rate will be after that date. Single-day registration starts at $625 and a digital pass (keynote livestream plus recordings) at $399. The venue has not been named on the conference pages yet.
